purpose: Compare frozen seed0 exports under one common protocol; simulation development evidence only

calibration.reference_error_scale: q95 squared scaled residual per lead/target; floor1e-8
calibration.domain_scores: mean normalized squared residual; propulsion p/q/r, battery pack voltage
calibration.selection: lowest quantile meeting target, else least-rate target_unmet

primary_metrics: normal union/domain alarm episodes per valid hour with exposure
all-event, conditional, unavailable and new-episode recall
step/ramp onset delays and preexisting observation-based recognition
forecast MAE/RMSE/signed bias on common valid origins

uncertainty.anomaly_grouping: 144 scenarios across 24 paired groups; not 144 independent groups
uncertainty.zero_event_poisson: reference only under constant independent rate assumption

interpretation.airframe: x500-reference-001 only; no real-flight generalization claim

preserve: normal validation/calibration exact residuals and identities
calibration threshold and normal-only fit provenance
physical residuals and raw domain scores
later_reassessment: New explicit criteria in a separate output; keep original results. No automatic follow-up.
